from scipy.optimize import least_squares


def calibrate_affine_gauges(command: np.ndarray, measured: np.ndarray, check_group: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, prior: np.ndarray, *, stress_scale: float, archive: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None = None, span_min: float = 0.10, residual_tol: float = 0.001, map_tol: float = 0.001) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return [gain, physical bias] in requested group order and a mask of
    resolved local sweeps. Prior biases and stresses share physical units.
    Archive contains command, measurement and group vectors from a comparable
    period. Span and residual thresholds are fractions of stress_scale;
    map_tol applies to gain and normalized bias. No gain ridge is used:
    unresolved sweeps retain the prior gain unless a compatible pool resolves it.
    """
    if not all(0 < v < np.inf for v in (stress_scale, span_min, residual_tol, map_tol)):
        raise ValueError('calibration scales and tolerances must be positive and finite')
    groups = np.asarray(groups)
    maps = np.array(prior, dtype=float, copy=True)
    if groups.ndim != 1 or maps.shape != (groups.size, 2) or not np.isfinite(maps).all() or np.any(maps[:, 0] <= 0):
        raise ValueError('expected one finite positive-gain prior per group')
    maps[:, 1] /= stress_scale
    supported = np.zeros(groups.size, dtype=bool)

    def panel(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, labels: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float) / stress_scale
        y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float) / stress_scale
        labels = np.asarray(labels)
        if x.ndim != 1 or x.shape != y.shape or x.shape != labels.shape:
            raise ValueError('expected matching check vectors')
        keep = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
        return x[keep], y[keep], labels[keep]

    def line(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack((x, np.ones(x.size))), y, rcond=None)[0]

    cx, cy, cg = panel(command, measured, check_group)
    hx, hy, hg = panel(*archive) if archive is not None else (cx[:0], cy[:0], cg[:0])
    for k, group in enumerate(groups):
        x, y = cx[cg == group], cy[cg == group]
        base = maps[k].copy()
        i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
        separated = np.abs(x[j] - x[i]) >= span_min
        i, j = i[separated], j[separated]
        slopes = (y[j] - y[i]) / (x[j] - x[i])
        candidates = np.vstack((base, np.column_stack((slopes, y[i] - slopes * x[i]))))
        best, local, inliers = None, None, None
        for gain, bias in candidates:
            if gain <= 0:
                continue
            keep = np.abs(y - gain * x - bias) <= residual_tol
            if keep.sum() < 3 or np.ptp(x[keep]) < span_min:
                continue
            fit = line(x[keep], y[keep])
            err = y - fit[0] * x - fit[1]
            keep = np.abs(err) <= residual_tol
            if fit[0] <= 0 or keep.sum() < 3 or np.ptp(x[keep]) < span_min:
                continue
            score = (-int(keep.sum()), float(err[keep] @ err[keep]))
            if best is None or score < best:
                best, local, inliers = score, fit, keep
        supported[k] = local is not None
        if local is not None and np.max(np.abs(local - base)) > map_tol:
            maps[k] = local
            continue
        delta = y - base[0] * x - base[1]
        agrees = np.abs(delta) <= residual_tol
        old = (hg == group) & (np.abs(hy - base[0] * hx - base[1]) <= residual_tol)
        pool = agrees if inliers is None else agrees & inliers
        xx, yy = np.r_[hx[old], x[pool]], np.r_[hy[old], y[pool]]
        if old.any() and xx.size >= 2 and np.ptp(xx) >= span_min:
            fit = line(xx, yy)
            if fit[0] > 0:
                maps[k] = fit
                continue
        if local is not None:
            maps[k] = local
        elif agrees.any():
            maps[k, 1] += np.median(delta[agrees])
    maps[:, 1] *= stress_scale
    return maps, supported


def align_reference_features(raw: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray, group: np.ndarray, stratum: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return aligned, imputed features and the original complete-row mask.
    Comparable reference coupons and features share a positive affine gauge
    per group. Use medians of reference-column means and population spreads
    on columns with at least two finite observations. Supplied rows may
    include unlabeled prediction rows. Impute with the equally weighted mean
    of contributing cell means. Unsupported features or scales raise; no
    scale floor is applied.
    """
    x = np.array(raw, dtype=float, copy=True)
    ref = np.asarray(reference, dtype=float)
    group, stratum = np.asarray(group), np.asarray(stratum)
    if x.ndim != 2 or not x.size or ref.ndim != 2 or len(ref) != len(x) or group.shape != (len(x),) or stratum.shape != group.shape:
        raise ValueError('expected feature and reference matrices with matching row labels')
    _, g = np.unique(group, return_inverse=True)
    _, s = np.unique(stratum, return_inverse=True)
    observed = np.isfinite(x)
    for label in np.unique(g):
        rows = g == label
        panel = ref[rows]
        keep = np.isfinite(panel).sum(axis=0) >= 2
        if not keep.any():
            raise ValueError('group has no supported reference column')
        panel = panel[:, keep]
        panel = np.where(np.isfinite(panel), panel, np.nan)
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(panel, axis=0))
        scale = np.median(np.nanstd(panel, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not 0 < scale < np.inf:
            raise ValueError('group requires a finite positive reference scale')
        x[rows] = (x[rows] - center) / scale
    cells, ids = np.unique(np.column_stack((g, s)), axis=0, return_inverse=True)
    ids = ids.reshape(-1)
    count = np.zeros((len(cells), x.shape[1]))
    total = np.zeros_like(count)
    np.add.at(count, ids, observed)
    np.add.at(total, ids, np.where(observed, x, 0.0))
    support = (count > 0).sum(axis=0)
    if np.any(support == 0):
        raise ValueError('feature is unobserved in every cell')
    means = np.divide(total, count, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=count > 0)
    return np.where(observed, x, means.sum(axis=0) / support), observed.all(axis=1)


def fit_thresholded_creep(history: np.ndarray, hold: np.ndarray, durations: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray, initial_strain: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, complete: np.ndarray, training: np.ndarray, strain_observed: np.ndarray, rate_observed: np.ndarray, *, yield_stress: float, stress_scale: float, time_scale: float, strain_scale: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], cauchy_k: float = 2.5, noise_floor: float = 1e-8, rank_rtol: float = 1e-8) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit constant-hold creep after chronological piecewise-constant stresses
    with shared interval durations and zero initial branch memory. Use
    calibrated stresses and complete training rows; omit missing responses.
    Return physical (ordered taus, hereditary weights, plastic weights,
    strain curves, onset rates). Hereditary weights are two amplitudes, the
    drift intercept, then feature slopes. Plastic weights multiply signed
    squared hold overstress times elapsed time, and the history integral of
    squared overstress times signed hold stress and the fast Prony response.

    Normalize by supplied physical scales. Initialize with multistart soft-L1
    at dimensionless scale 0.02, then profile weighted least squares for
    eight Cauchy updates, refreshing per-horizon and onset-rate MAD scales
    each time. No coefficient ridge is used. Unobserved plastic terms are
    fixed at zero; refuse prediction rows that require an unsupported term.
    A finite onset rate on an incomplete non-training row is assumed trusted
    and updates only the row's constant drift.
    """
    if not all(0 < v < np.inf for v in (yield_stress, stress_scale, time_scale, strain_scale, cauchy_k, noise_floor, rank_rtol)):
        raise ValueError('physical scales and fit tolerances must be positive and finite')
    h = np.asarray(history, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    p = np.asarray(hold, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    d = np.asarray(durations, dtype=float) / time_scale
    t = np.asarray(times, dtype=float) / time_scale
    x = np.asarray(features, dtype=float)
    eps0 = np.asarray(initial_strain, dtype=float)
    complete, training = np.asarray(complete, dtype=bool), np.asarray(training, dtype=bool)
    obs = np.asarray(strain_observed, dtype=float)
    rate_unit = strain_scale / time_scale
    rate = np.asarray(rate_observed, dtype=float) / rate_unit
    lo, hi = np.asarray(tau_bounds, dtype=float) / time_scale
    n = p.size
    if p.ndim != 1 or h.ndim != 2 or h.shape[0] != n or d.shape != (h.shape[1],) or t.ndim != 1 or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != n or obs.shape != (n, t.size) or any(v.shape != (n,) for v in (eps0, complete, training, rate)):
        raise ValueError('inconsistent specimen, interval or observation shapes')
    if not all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in (h, p, d, t, x, eps0)) or not 0 < lo < hi < np.inf or np.any(d < 0) or not t.size or t[0] < 0 or np.any(np.diff(t) <= 0):
        raise ValueError('expected finite inputs, nonnegative durations and increasing times and bounds')
    cov = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), x))
    sy = yield_stress / stress_scale
    ov = np.sign(p) * np.maximum(np.abs(p) - sy, 0.0)**2
    work = (np.maximum(np.abs(h) - sy, 0.0)**2 @ d) * p
    tail = (np.r_[np.cumsum(d[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0] if d.size else d)[:, None]
    use = complete & training
    cr, cc = np.nonzero(use[:, None] & np.isfinite(obs))
    rr = np.flatnonzero(use & np.isfinite(rate))
    y = np.r_[(obs[cr, cc] - eps0[cr]) / strain_scale, rate[rr]]
    pt = t[cc, None]
    positive_rows = np.r_[cr[pt[:, 0] > 0], rr]
    excited = np.array([np.any(ov[positive_rows]), np.any(work[positive_rows])])
    requested = np.array([np.any(ov[~training]), np.any(work[~training])])
    if np.any(requested & ~excited):
        raise ValueError('prediction excites a plastic term not supported by training observations')
    active = np.r_[np.ones(cov.shape[1] + 2, dtype=bool), excited]
    nw = int(active.sum())
    if not len(cr) or not len(rr) or y.size < nw + 2:
        raise ValueError('insufficient complete strain and onset-rate observations')

    def memory(tau: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        kernel = np.exp(-tail / tau) * -np.expm1(-d[:, None] / tau)
        end = np.exp(-(tail + d[:, None]) / tau)
        dj = -h @ ((tail * kernel - d[:, None] * end) / tau)
        return p[:, None] - h @ kernel, dj

    def design(tau: np.ndarray, coeff: np.ndarray | None = None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray | None]:
        j, dj = memory(tau)
        phi = -np.expm1(-pt / tau)
        strain = np.column_stack((j[cr] * phi, cov[cr] * pt, ov[cr] * pt[:, 0], work[cr] * phi[:, 0]))
        onset = np.column_stack((j[rr] / tau, cov[rr], ov[rr], work[rr] / tau[0]))
        a = np.vstack((strain, onset))[:, active]
        if coeff is None:
            return a, None
        dphi = -(pt / tau) * np.exp(-pt / tau)
        curve_tangent = (dj[cr] * phi + j[cr] * dphi) * coeff[:2]
        rate_tangent = ((dj[rr] - j[rr]) / tau) * coeff[:2]
        if excited[1]:
            curve_tangent[:, 0] += coeff[-1] * work[cr] * dphi[:, 0]
            rate_tangent[:, 0] -= coeff[-1] * work[rr] / tau[0]
        return a, np.vstack((curve_tangent, rate_tangent))

    lower = np.log(lo)
    span = np.log(hi) - lower

    def ordered(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        a, b = q[:2]
        return np.exp(lower + span * np.array([a, a + (1.0 - a) * b]))

    def seed_residual(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return design(ordered(q))[0] @ q[2:] - y

    def seed_jacobian(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        a, tangent = design(ordered(q), q[2:])
        transform = span * np.array([[1.0, 0.0], [1.0 - q[1], 1.0 - q[0]]])
        return np.column_stack((tangent @ transform, a))

    low = np.array([0.0, 1e-5])
    high = np.array([1.0 - 1e-5, 1.0])
    seed_bounds = (np.r_[low, np.full(nw, -np.inf)], np.r_[high, np.full(nw, np.inf)])
    starts = ((0.12, 0.34), (0.25, 0.65), (0.45, 0.65), (0.65, 0.50))
    fits = []
    for start in starts:
        q0 = np.asarray(start)
        a = design(ordered(q0))[0]
        w0 = np.linalg.lstsq(a, y, rcond=None)[0]
        fits.append(least_squares(seed_residual, np.r_[q0, w0], jac=seed_jacobian,
                                  bounds=seed_bounds, loss='soft_l1', f_scale=0.02, max_nfev=200))
    seed = min(fits, key=lambda fit: fit.cost).x
    q, err = seed[:2], seed_residual(seed)
    channel = np.r_[cc, np.full(len(rr), t.size)]
    channels = [channel == k for k in np.unique(channel)]
    scale = np.empty_like(y)
    weight = np.ones_like(y)

    def profile(q: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        a = design(ordered(q))[0]
        coeff = np.linalg.lstsq(a * weight[:, None], y * weight, rcond=None)[0]
        return coeff, a @ coeff - y

    def objective(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return weight * profile(q)[1]

    for _ in range(8):
        for rows in channels:
            e = err[rows]
            scale[rows] = max(noise_floor, 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(e - np.median(e))))
        weight = 1.0 / np.hypot(scale, err / cauchy_k)
        weight /= weight.max()
        opt = least_squares(objective, q, bounds=(low, high), max_nfev=120,
                            gtol=1e-12, ftol=1e-11, xtol=1e-11)
        q = opt.x
        coeff, err = profile(q)

    tau = ordered(q)
    a, tangent = design(tau, coeff)
    jac = np.column_stack((tangent, a))
    singular = np.linalg.svd(jac * weight[:, None], compute_uv=False)
    if not opt.success or singular[-1] <= rank_rtol * singular[0]:
        raise ValueError('shared law did not converge to an identifiable solution')

    theta = np.zeros(active.size)
    theta[active] = coeff
    amplitude = memory(tau)[0] * theta[:2]
    amplitude[:, 0] += work * theta[-1]
    drift = cov @ theta[2:-2] + ov * theta[-2]
    transient_rate = amplitude @ (1.0 / tau)
    anchor = ~training & ~complete & np.isfinite(rate)
    drift[anchor] = rate[anchor] - transient_rate[anchor]
    curve = eps0[:, None] + strain_scale * (amplitude @ -np.expm1(-t[None, :] / tau[:, None]) + drift[:, None] * t)
    hereditary = theta[:-2] * np.r_[np.full(2, strain_scale / stress_scale), np.full(cov.shape[1], rate_unit)]
    plastic = theta[-2:] * rate_unit / stress_scale**np.array([2, 3])
    return tau * time_scale, hereditary, plastic, curve, rate_unit * (transient_rate + drift)

        close(wf, w, atol=2e-4)
        if mixed:
            close(vf, v, atol=2e-4)
        else:
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(vf, [0., 0.])
        drift_error = (x[-1] - truth[-1]) @ w[3:]
        expected, expected_rate = strain.copy(), onset.copy()
        expected[-1] += drift_error * t
        expected_rate[-1] += drift_error
        close(pred, expected, atol=5e-4)
        close(rate, expected_rate, atol=3e-4)
        close(rate[-2], rates[-2], atol=1e-12)
        close(pred[:, 0], eps0, atol=1e-12)
        scaled = fit_thresholded_creep(f * hist, f * hold, k * dt, k * t, eps0, xg[back], cg[back], train, obs, rates / k, yield_stress=2. * f, stress_scale=2. * f, time_scale=1.5 * k, strain_scale=.1, tau_bounds=(.12 * k, 9. * k))
        tt, ww, vv, pp, rr = scaled
        for actual, original in zip((tt / k, ww * [f, f, k, k, k], vv * k * np.array([f**2, f**3]), pp, rr * k), result):
            close(actual, original, rtol=2e-5, atol=2e-7)
        if not mixed:
            unsupported_hold = hold.copy()
            unsupported_hold[-1] = 2.5
            with np.testing.assert_raises_regex(ValueError, 'not supported'):
                fit_thresholded_creep(hist, unsupported_hold, dt, t, eps0, x, complete, train, obs, rates, **kwargs)
